inference_limits.checkpoints: Start of fixed hand numbers and first live hand with <=6/4/3/2 players; hero must be alive. No outcome-based inclusion.
inference_limits.finish_rank: Official place rule: simultaneous busts ordered by start-of-hand stack, ties share better place; survivors at cap ranked by stack. Win/top3 refer to these ranks.
inference_limits.points: Official equity_after at final hand, rounded to 4 decimals in archive; independently matches public round mean to reporting precision.
inference_limits.intervals: Unadjusted pointwise normal 95% intervals over independent iterations; exactly one non-filler hero table per iteration verified. Many exploratory strata: intervals are descriptive, not selection-adjusted.
inference_limits.ICM: Malmuth-Harville descriptive null, not calibrated probability or counterfactual action value. Exact top3 probabilities, E[rank]=1+sum(other/(hero+other)).
inference_limits.selection: Later checkpoints condition on survival and opponents/table state; round/version/field are confounded. No causal policy comparison.
inference_limits.accounting: Sum of per-hand ICM point changes grouped by players BEFORE hand; telescopes to final points minus initial points. Includes equity changes caused by other players.
inference_limits.currencies: own_bb and stack_share use ordinary chips only; auction chips reported separately.

actual_decision_paths: agent.py:13 auction -> TournamentAgent.act; tournament_agent.py:14-21 returns auction_bids before betting risk_premium code.
agent.py:16 preflop -> choose_preflop_loose; independent_preflop.py:93-97 only counts paid places and adds 0.035 to selected bubble call thresholds.
agent.py:16 postflop -> classic_policy.postflop(price_veto=True, contribution_veto=True); no payout or ICM action-value calculation.
classic_policy.equity samples uniformly from unknown opponent hole cards, not action-conditioned ranges; postflop uses pot odds and fixed hand-class/commitment rules.
current_policy_objective_audit.verdict: The benchmark rewards final tournament points and uses ICM at the hand cap. The deployed policy is selected for that objective but does not explicitly maximize expected ICM value per action. Existing payout-awareness is a limited preflop heuristic.

top_three_macro_hypotheses.name: Range-conditioned action-value policy across all stages
top_three_macro_hypotheses.evidence: S1 and P5 repeat HU conversion deficits concentrated at 10-40 effective BB and below 65% entry share; early and middle checkpoints also show falling conversion. Current Hboth equity source samples uniformly, ignoring the information in bets.
top_three_macro_hypotheses.proposal: Infer bounded opponent ranges from position, prior actions and bet sizes; compare fold/call/raise values with a shared value representation through later streets. Use a small action set and immutable precomputed tables, with per-table public updates.
top_three_macro_hypotheses.scope_for_two_points: Extend beyond HU. Closing the observed HU chip-share-reference gap accounts for only 0.239/0.279 points per starting table in S1/P5.
top_three_macro_hypotheses.falsification: A separately frozen field and fresh seeds must show at least +2 over exact Hboth, with reported interval, zero execution failures, and no collapse in stage-specific utility.

top_three_macro_hypotheses.name: Tournament-point value at decision leaves, not blanket risk aversion
top_three_macro_hypotheses.evidence: The deployed source does not compute ICM alternatives. S1/P5 exhibit losses of 0.344/0.394 points per initial table during 3-player plus HU play; medium-stack three-player residuals are negative. Overall top3 rates exceed symmetry while wins do not, so maximizing wins alone would be the wrong objective.
top_three_macro_hypotheses.proposal: Evaluate fold, win, lose and split stack vectors in payout units; make risk depend on the actual payout increments, coverage and players left. For HU, ICM is linear in stack share, so extra bubble risk margins cannot solve the observed HU deficit.
top_three_macro_hypotheses.causal_limit: ICM residuals are descriptive null-model discrepancies and may reflect opponent skill/ranges. They do not prove that adding ICM will recover these points.

top_three_macro_hypotheses.name: Joint auction and continuation value with a normal-chip value for auction budget
top_three_macro_hypotheses.evidence: The auction path optimizes a separate hand-quality/budget heuristic; subsequent betting uses another value model. Low auction inventory at HU entry correlates with poorer conversion in broad strata, but matched cross-strata are sparse and do not establish a causal budget effect.
top_three_macro_hypotheses.proposal: Value each candidate flop and bid by the same downstream range-aware tournament-point model, including the future value of saved auction chips and the current effective stack/pot. Keep ordinary chips and auction currency separate.
top_three_macro_hypotheses.confidence: Architectural hypothesis with weaker direct empirical support than priority 1; do not infer that simply saving or spending more auction chips improves outcomes.

not_a_current_policy_live_evaluation: P4 is old hybrid; S1 and P5 are corrected loose. None evaluates the newly deployed Hboth.
no_score_promise: These observations motivate experiments; no +2 improvement has been established.
